name: popsicle
headline: Create social clips with Clipify AI
short_description: Clipify automates conversion of long-form videos into short-form social media clips using AI-driven speech recognition, content analysis, and intelligent editing.
author: GetRepliq

sections.overview:
Clipify is an open-source tool that automates the extraction of engaging moments from long-form videos and converts them into short-form content optimized for social platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat. It uses speech recognition to transcribe audio, natural language processing to identify key moments, and computer vision to detect visually important segments. The platform handles automatic trimming, dynamic resizing for different aspect ratios, and caption generation. Content creators, marketers, and video producers benefit by eliminating manual editing workflows and reducing time spent repurposing video content across multiple platforms.
Convert podcast episodes into short social media clips with captions
Extract highlight reels from webinars and conference talks
Transform long YouTube videos into Instagram Reels and TikTok videos
Generate story-ready clips from livestreams and events

Transform this [VIDEO LINK] into 3-5 engaging social media clips for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Each clip should be under 60 seconds and highlight key moments. Use the following guidelines: [GUIDELINES].
